tempPassword.title: Temporary password
tempPassword.body: Share this password with {{name}} now. It is shown only once and they must change it at first sign-in.

orgs.title: Organizations
orgs.subtitle: Every organization on the platform. Open one to manage its people, features and flags.

empty.title: No organizations found
empty.body: Try a different search or filter, or create the first organization.

create.title: Create an organization
create.body: This also creates its first organization admin with a one-time temporary password.
create.name: Organization name
create.slugHint: Optional. Built from the name when left empty.

org.enableBody: People can sign in again and new exams can start.
org.disableBody: No new sign-ins or exam starts. Exams already in progress can finish. Nothing is deleted.
org.reason: Reason (optional, kept in the audit log)

overview.created: Created {{date}}. Candidate answers and snapshots are never shown to the platform team.

admins.hint: Only the platform team can create or change organization admins.

confirm.resetBody: A new temporary password replaces the current one and all their sessions end.
confirm.reactivateBody: They can sign in again with their current password.
confirm.deactivateBody: They can no longer sign in. Their data is kept.
confirm.lastBody: {{name}} is the last active admin of this organization. Without an admin nobody there can manage the team until you add or reactivate one.

addDialog.title: Add an organization admin
addDialog.body: They get a one-time temporary password and must choose a new one at first sign-in.
addDialog.name: Full name

flags.orgBody: Turn a feature off to hide it and block its API for this organization. Data is kept.
flags.defaultsBody: The starting set copied into every new organization. Organizations that already exist keep their current values.
flags.blocked: Off because a required feature is off
flags.reason: Reason (optional, kept in the audit log)
flags.defaultsSaved: Defaults saved. New organizations will use them.

dashboard_gadgets.label: Dashboard gadgets
dashboard_gadgets.hint: Let people arrange their own dashboard gadgets.

assessments.label: Assessments
assessments.hint: Assessments tab and the assessment builder.

ai_question_builder.label: AI question builder
ai_question_builder.hint: AI question suggestions in the builder.

ai_scoring.label: AI scoring
ai_scoring.hint: AI scoring of short answers and code gaps.

roles.label: Roles
roles.hint: Open roles that candidates are invited to.

csv_bulk_invite.label: CSV bulk invite
csv_bulk_invite.hint: Invite many candidates from a CSV file.

email_sending.label: Email sending
email_sending.hint: Send invites and notices by email.

help_requests.label: Help requests
help_requests.hint: Candidates can ask for help during an exam.

camera_proctoring.label: Camera proctoring
camera_proctoring.hint: Camera checks and snapshots during exams.

reports_chat.label: Reports chat
reports_chat.hint: Ask for reports in plain language.

ai_provider_setup.label: AI provider setup
ai_provider_setup.hint: Settings section for connecting an AI provider.

watermark.label: Platform watermark
watermark.hint: Marks exports and screens with the platform name. Organizations never see this flag.

misuse.raised: Misuse flag raised. The organization admins were notified.
misuse.cleared: Misuse flag cleared. The organization admins were notified.

empty.title: No misuse flags
empty.body: Raise a flag when this organization breaks the usage rules.

raiseDialog.title: Raise a misuse flag for {{name}}
raiseDialog.body: The organization admins see your comment in a notification.

branding.title: Platform branding
branding.subtitle: The theme for platform admin screens and the sign-in page. Organization themes are not affected.
branding.resetBody: The platform theme goes back to the starter colors, font and background.

usage.title: AI usage
usage.subtitle: AI calls and tokens per organization. Counts only, never content.
usage.empty: No usage recorded for this month.
